answer: Make every agent plant a slow-maturing tenure bond before it can earn: a small stake locked for weeks that only unlocks full rewards after sustained honest work. A sybil farmer spinning up an island of fresh identities must fund and wait out each bond, so mass creation costs real time and capital. If one account misbehaves, the penalty sends a ripple through its whole grove of linked accounts, slashing every connected bond at once and turning a cheap swarm into an expensive loss.
